packages/security/src/lonora_security/__.name: Security package
packages/security/src/lonora_security/__.description: Marks the security code as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/security/src/lonora_security/co.name: Collaboration limits
packages/security/src/lonora_security/co.description: Keeps agent-to-agent work within the same owner and within a depth limit.

packages/security/src/lonora_security/fi.name: Trade validation
packages/security/src/lonora_security/fi.description: Checks a trade's symbol, size and prices fit the instrument's rules before anything is sent.

packages/security/src/lonora_security/ne.name: Safe web addresses
packages/security/src/lonora_security/ne.description: Checks an outside address is safe to call and fingerprints it.

packages/security/src/lonora_security/ot.name: Safe update-file reads
packages/security/src/lonora_security/ot.description: Reads phone-update files without following any planted shortcut.

packages/security/src/lonora_security/pu.name: Safe public fetch
packages/security/src/lonora_security/pu.description: Makes a size-bounded, anonymous web request pinned to the address that passed the safety check.

packages/security/src/lonora_security/ru.name: Confined paths
packages/security/src/lonora_security/ru.description: Keeps a file path inside its allowed folder, refusing anything that escapes it.

packages/security/src/lonora_security/se.name: Secret scrubbing
packages/security/src/lonora_security/se.description: Finds and replaces a secret's value — in all its encoded forms — anywhere it might appear in text, so secrets never leak out.
